headline: History
lead: Greater Sacramento has hosted civic Tết (Lunar New Year) and Tết Trung Thu (Mid-Autumn Festival): a civic Hội Chợ Tết that later moved to Elk Grove Park, a civic moon and family fair, and separate calendars at Kim Quang Buddhist Temple and Vietnamese Martyrs Parish.
hideMafHelp: Hides Civic Tết Trung Thu, parish-hall Mid-Autumn, and Kim Quang lantern walks — so the page is Tết only.

cta.label: Celebrate with us in 2027
cta.note: Festival posters and press tapes also live on [Media](/resources/media/).

blocks.title: Vietnamese Martyrs Parish dedicates the sanctuary
paragraphs: The parish opens 8181 Florin Road. Sundays had stayed on Jackson Road until this Mass. The personal parish is erected Sunday, November 29, 2009. There is no Florin Tết fair this year — Tết Kỷ Sửu was Monday, January 26, before the dedication.

paragraphs: The temple site is complete. Campus Tết stays lễ, GĐPT văn nghệ, and lân.

blocks.title: Moon Festival 2019 — first civic Tết Trung Thu
paragraphs: A community-center evening at the Vietnamese Community Center, 6270 Elder Creek Road. The night was billed Moon Festival 2019; VACOS page copy also said Tết Trung Thu 2019. Hosts were VACOS and Lac Hong Center. Free; 5:00 PM; kids contests. Lunar Mid-Autumn was Friday, September 13. This is not the later Florin Towne plaza fair.

blocks.title: First Florin Towne civic Tết Trung Thu
paragraphs: Mid-Autumn Moon Celebration / Mừng Tết Trung Thu 2021 at the Sears parking lot, 5901 Florin Road (postponed from Saturday, September 25). 11:00 AM–10:00 PM; Little Saigon Night Market 6:00–10:00 PM. Presented by NVCC + cPALSs. KCRA billed a “first annual” plaza night market — that is this product, after the 2019 Elder Creek evening.
